summary.text: Aron Maberry is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 68, part of Montgomery County, who lives in Clarksville, took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a pastor and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Maberry was born in Altus, Oklahoma, and graduated from Rossview High School in 2003 and Valor Christian College in 2007.
The legislature's biography lists him as a pastor and small business owner, and Ballotpedia also notes work in marketing and graphic design.
He has served on the Clarksville-Montgomery County School System school board for District 7 since 2022 and completed Leadership Clarksville in 2024 and Leadership CMCSS in 2022.
Maberry has been a member of the House since the 114th General Assembly and serves on the Education, Government Operations and Transportation committees.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Garfield Scott in the general election.
